summary: Iteration 24: full E2E testing of (1) new POST /api/sri/facturas/{id}/categorize endpoint, (2) SriMatch.js redesign with 2-section layout (Por categorizar / Vinculadas), and (3) Deudas.js card update-date block + stale badge. Backend: 4/4 pytest pass. Frontend (1440x900, admin earauzt): all data-testids render correctly; categorize flow E2E works (factura moved from 'Por categorizar' 7->6 to 'Vinculadas' 1->2 after selecting Comida). Pichincha Platinum reprocessed values verified end-to-end.

issues: Could not visually verify the 'Datos desactualizados' yellow badge in this run because all 4 cards have updated_at=22 abr 2026 (today in app context) — none are >30 days old. The conditional render logic exists at Deudas.js line 526 with data-testid='card-stale-{id}'. To force-visualize, main agent could backdate one card.updated_at by >30 days.

passed_tests: POST /api/sri/facturas/{doc_id}/categorize {category:'comida', subcategory:'restaurantes'} -> 200 with {tx_id, linked, linked_bank, linked_tx_id}; gmail_document.budget_category updated to 'comida'
GET /api/credit-cards: Pichincha Platinum has credit_limit=5000, saldo_diferido=850.42, pago_total=2009.16 (reprocessed by main agent via regex fallback)
Frontend /sri-match: data-testid='por-categorizar-section' (7 facturas) and 'vinculadas-section' (1 factura) both render
Frontend /sri-match: NO 'Match aproximado' nor 'Sin vincular' tabs in body text (legacy tabs removed)
Frontend /sri-match: 7 factura-categorizar-{id} buttons render, all clickable
Frontend /sri-match: click factura -> transaction-edit-modal opens; tem-establishment-input pre-filled with 'Via Samborondon Km. 3 Samborondon Normal'
Frontend /sri-match: select 'Comida' category + tem-save-btn -> POST /api/sri/facturas/{id}/categorize returns; modal closes; por-categorizar count 7->6; vinculadas count 1->2 (E2E verified)
Frontend /sri-match: factura-vinculada-{id} cards show ver-pdf-{id} button (verified for 7f6c0d42-...)
Frontend /deudas: 4 card-updates-{id} blocks render (one per card)
Frontend /deudas: 4 card-updated-at-{id} render with 'Actualizado: 22 abr 2026' for all cards
Frontend /deudas: 4 card-statement-date-{id} render — Pichincha (x2) shows 'Periodo: 17 abr 2026', another shows '03 feb 2026', another '31 dic 2025' (matches admin spec for Pichincha)
Frontend /deudas: card-stale logic present in code (Deudas.js:526) but not triggered with current data (all cards within 30 days)
critical_code_review_comments: sri_match.categorize_factura: clean implementation. Auto-link uses ±5% amount + ±7 days date window as spec requires; bidirectional update on transactions + gmail_documents; sets estado_sri='con_respaldo' if linked else 'pendiente_match'. Good.

sri_match.categorize_factura line 447: filter `factura_vinculada_id: {$in: [None, ''}}` correctly excludes already-linked consumos. linked_bank fallback chain (banco -> bank -> payment_method) is sensible.
SriMatch.js: clean 2-section layout. Removed legacy tabs (Match aproximado / Sin vincular). TransactionEditModal reuse is the right call — single source of truth maintained from iteration 23.
SriMatch.js: handleCategorize toast messages are clear in Spanish ('Categorizada y vinculada con {banco}' / 'Factura categorizada (sin consumo vinculado)').
Deudas.js line 515-530: card-updates block with stale badge (>30 days) is well-scoped per card. Uses data-testid pattern card-{role}-{card.id} consistently.
(Minor a11y) DialogDescription warning from iteration 23 in TransactionEditModal single-mode still pending — non-blocking.
seed_data_creation: One factura was categorized as 'comida' during the E2E flow test (Via Samborondon Km. 3, doc id fc654b4c-cd35-4de0-848e-eb1671e34e8a). It moved from 'Por categorizar' to 'Vinculadas'. This is expected test side-effect.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 3 features in iteration 24 verified end-to-end. /app/backend/tests/test_iteration24_batch.py is reusable as regression. The only visual gap was the 'Datos desactualizados' yellow badge — code is correct (Deudas.js:526 with data-testid='card-stale-{id}') but no current card meets >30 days threshold (all 4 cards have updated_at=22 abr 2026 = today in app context). To verify visually, backdate one card.updated_at by >30 days in DB. Pichincha Platinum reprocessed values (credit_limit=5000, saldo_diferido=850.42, pago_total=2009.16) confirmed both via API and in the /deudas UI screenshot.
rca of the issue: N/A — no issues blocking. The 'Datos desactualizados' badge non-visualization is a data-state, not a bug.
